published_baseline: Founder-approved public-surface isolation recovery. /global-risk is restored to its dedicated Global Risk workspace and reads the proof-validated Global Risk Cloudflare/B2 edge; /risk-indices remains the separate three-index product and reads its own independently published, proof-bound Risk Indices Cloudflare/B2 edge. Intelligence and Ask keep their own API/runtime contracts. Shared canonical verified evidence may be read by publishers, but customer-serving state, B2 live/proof objects, workers, browser hooks, schedules and compatibility APIs are isolated so repairing one product surface does not replace or overwrite another. Missing or stale verified data remains explicit; no synthetic score, zero fallback, history interpolation, payment weakening or source-rights bypass is allowed.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
